title: API testing with the request fixture
summary: Test the todos JSON API directly: create a todo (201 + body), find it in the list, and check that an empty title is rejected with 400.
why: API tests are fast and precise: they check status codes and contracts without a browser, and they are the cheapest way to seed or verify data for UI tests.
objectives: Use the request fixture: async ({ request }) => …
POST returns 201 with { id, title, done: false }
The new todo appears in GET /api/todos
pitfalls: Only checking response.ok() — 200 instead of 201, or a missing body, passes.
Depending on data from another test — create what you need in the test.
teachAlong: Cause: assert status and body, not just 'ok'.
Gate: a planted bug returns 200 without the created todo.
